verdict.rationale: a-Shell supports scripted automation through Apple Shortcuts, which the docs say gives "full control of the Shell" for complex download/process/release workflows; `.profile` startup scripts add some unattended setup. Nothing shows a true headless mode or any way to run it in CI, so this is on-device automation rather than CI-style operation. Missing for 10: documented headless/background execution, CI or server-side runner support, non-interactive invocation outside Shortcuts, and independent hands-on corroboration.
